info.description: A picture beside words. The words wrap beneath the picture once there are more of them than the picture is tall.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Layout
edit.description: Which side the picture sits on, from 1024 pixels wide. Below that the picture always sits above the words.

edit.label: Image
edit.description: Its title and caption sit in the column of words rather than under the picture.
